text: This report recommends the award of Request for Quotation (RFQ) RFQ 04 to Supply and Deliver Switchgear, 27.6 KV Metal-Enclosed, Replacement at Main Service Entrance to a vendor.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Authorized the Director, Capital Program and Sustainability, or her designate, to award and enter into an Agreement for Request for Quotation (RFQ) RFQ 04 - Supply and Deliver Switchgear, 27.6 KV Metal-Enclosed, Replacement at Main Service Entrance to Wesco Distribution Canada LP. Up to a commitment of $531,362.00 excluding HST.
